name: Friend's Harem Corruption
source:
This is a story where the MC is often overshadowed by others in the world, being seen as a secondary character, except for his exceptional intellect. The MC befriends Naoki, a widely adored individual known for his charm. Drawing upon his intellect, the MC assists Naoki in accomplishing something remarkable: capturing the hearts of specific girls and getting them engaged with him. However, one day, the appearance of a woman changes everything for both of them, damaging their relationship forever and ushering in a new chapter in their lives. Play as the MC and use different tools and abilities to corrupt Naoki's harem!
This story is basically a parody of the typical harem trope.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/due-to-my-new-situation-i-have-to-corrupt-my-friends-harem-v0-14-warrior-novels.161637/]F95zone[/url]]
translation:
故事中的主人公，除了过人的智慧，往往处处被别人抢去风头，被当作配角。他与魅力出众、人见人爱的Naoki成为朋友，并运用自己的智慧，帮助Naoki完成了一件了不起的事：赢得几位特定女孩的芳心，与她们订婚。然而某天，一位女性的出现，改变了两人的一切，永久破坏了彼此的关系，也为他们的人生揭开新篇章。扮演主人公，运用不同的工具与能力，让Naoki的后宫堕落！
本作基本上是对典型后宫套路的戏仿。

[摘自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/due-to-my-new-situation-i-have-to-corrupt-my-friends-harem-v0-14-warrior-novels.161637/]F95zone[/url]]
